summary: Greenlight Capital Re, Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Ordinary Share Repurchase Agreement with the David M. Einhorn 2021-07 Family Trust, an affiliate of Chairman David Einhorn, to repurchase shares to prevent his ownership from increasing due to adverse tax consequences. The repurchase price is the weighted average price per share paid under a 10b5-1 plan to be entered June 3, 2026, with closing expected on or about August 3, 2026. The mechanics tie share buybacks to a pre-arranged plan, ensuring proportional sales. Watch for execution of the 10b5-1 plan and any changes in Einhorn's stake.
